notes: "Busy" now means a real commitment. Someone scrolling, gaming, eating, having tea, walking around or winding down shows as Available on your phone, answers texts quickly and picks up calls; only shifts, classes, missions, rehearsals, recording, live shows, commissions and the like count as Busy. The story is told the same thing: casual activities are free time, and people can drop them to talk or hang out.
The schedule maker for your own characters now leaves real free time instead of booking every hour.

Angels of Delusion: much more free time, like in the game (lazy mornings, free afternoons and evenings around Sixth Street), and Nangong's money is written the way the game shows it: she funds the group from her own trading and hides it, while whether her family is rich is left a mystery.
